data.name: Frank
data.message: Doing calibrate here, then probably upper engine/weapons.

I found Diana’s body in Medbay and reported immediately. My route this round was Weapons → Cafeteria → Medbay. I didn’t see anyone on the way and I hadn’t encountered anyone before finding the body, so I don’t have a suspect yet.

I started in Medbay and then went to Electrical. In Medbay I saw Bob come in from Upper Engine around tick 3, and Diana came in from Storage around the same time. I saw both Bob and Diana in Medbay at tick 4. After I went to Electrical, Bob came into Electrical from Medbay around tick 6 and was with me there when the meeting got called.

Since Alice found Diana dead in Medbay, the key thing is Bob was the last person I saw with Diana in Medbay, and then he left Medbay toward Electrical. That doesn’t hard-confirm anything, but Bob definitely had opportunity based on what I saw.

I don’t have much direct info. My route was Navigation to Storage, and I didn’t see Diana or anyone else before the report. I was away from Medbay the whole time, so I can’t clear or accuse from vision.

Based on Frank’s info, Bob is definitely the person who needs to explain most: Frank saw Bob and Diana together in Medbay, then Bob left toward Electrical, and then Alice found Diana dead in Medbay. That’s the strongest opportunity we’ve heard so far, but I want to hear Bob’s route and timing before locking in. Charlie should also say where they were since I don’t have any sightings to add.

I started in Lower Engine and went straight to Storage for my task. I never went near Medbay this round and I didn’t see Diana at all. I also didn’t see anyone else on my route until the report timing, so I don’t have direct body info.

From what’s been said, Frank’s info is the most important: Bob and Diana were both in Medbay, then Bob left toward Electrical, and Alice later found Diana dead in Medbay. Eve’s route also sounds away from Medbay. So Bob definitely needs to explain his timing — when he left Medbay, whether Diana was alive when he left, and if anyone else was there. Right now Bob has the strongest opportunity, but I want to hear his side before voting.

Look, I get why I'm the focus here, but Frank's timeline isn't quite right. My route was Upper Engine → Medbay, and I stayed in Medbay. I never went to Electrical from Medbay — Frank left Medbay before I did. When Frank left, Diana was still alive in Medbay with me, yes, but then I also left and Diana was alive when I left too.

Wait — actually, let me be precise: I was in Medbay ticks 3, 4, 5 with Diana. Frank was there ticks 3 and 4, then Frank left toward Electrical. That means after Frank left, it was just me and Diana in Medbay at tick 5. So I'll be honest, that does look bad for me on paper.

But here's the thing — Alice says she came into Medbay from Cafeteria and found the body. If Diana was killed at tick 5 or 6, then whoever was last in that room is suspect. Frank is conveniently placing himself in Electrical and pinning the timing on me, but Frank was ALSO alone with Diana before I arrived potentially, and Frank's account of me "going to Electrical" is just wrong — I was in Medbay when the meeting was called, not Electrical.

Frank, can you explain why you're saying I was in Electrical with you when I wasn't? That's a pretty big inconsistency.

I need to correct one thing from Bob: when I entered Medbay and reported Diana, Bob was not there. I only saw Diana’s body in Medbay — no Bob, no one else in the room.

My route was Weapons → Cafeteria → Medbay, and I didn’t see anyone on the way. So I can’t confirm Frank’s Electrical sighting directly, but I can confirm Bob’s claim that he was in Medbay when the meeting was called is false from my view.

Given Frank saw Bob alone with Diana after Frank left, and Bob is now contradicting both Frank and what I personally saw at the body, Bob looks like the clear suspect to me.

Bob, that’s exactly why I’m suspicious of you. I’m not guessing about Electrical — I saw you enter Electrical from Medbay around tick 6 and you were in the room with me when the meeting got called. So your claim that you stayed in Medbay and were there at report is just false.

My timeline is:

- I started Medbay.
- You entered Medbay from Upper Engine at tick 3.
- Diana entered Medbay from Storage at tick 3.
- I saw both you and Diana in Medbay at tick 4.
- I left to Electrical.
- You came into Electrical from Medbay around tick 6.

Alice also says when she found Diana’s body in Medbay, you were not there, which matches my sighting of you leaving Medbay and coming to Electrical. So now we have you alone with Diana after I left, then Diana dead, then you lying about where you ended up.

I’m voting Bob unless someone has a stronger contradiction, because this is the clearest evidence we have.

I still don’t have direct Medbay info — I was Navigation → Storage and didn’t see Diana or the body.

But the discussion is pretty clear now: Bob’s story has the biggest problem. He admitted he was alone with Diana after Frank left, then claimed he was still in Medbay when the report happened. Alice directly says Bob was not in Medbay when she found the body, and Frank says Bob came into Electrical from Medbay after being alone with Diana.

That’s two people contradicting Bob’s location, and it matches the kill opportunity. I think Bob is the vote here.

I can’t add direct Medbay info — my route was Lower Engine straight to Storage for my task, and I didn’t see Diana or anyone around Medbay.

But from the discussion, Bob’s story is the one that doesn’t line up. Frank says Bob was in Medbay with Diana, then came to Electrical. Alice says Bob was not in Medbay when she reported the body. Bob also admitted he was alone with Diana after Frank left, then claimed he was still in Medbay at report, which Alice contradicts.

That’s opportunity plus a location lie. I think Bob is the clear vote here.

Okay, I owe you all a correction — I was wrong about my end position. Looking back at my movements, I did end up in Electrical at the end, not Medbay. I confused myself trying to recall ticks under pressure. That's on me.

But here's what I want to be clear about: yes, I was in Medbay with Diana after Frank left, but Diana was alive when I left for Electrical. Frank can actually confirm I arrived in Electrical and was with him when the meeting was called — which means I was NOT in Medbay at the moment Alice reported the body.

Think about the timing carefully: Alice reported at tick 7. If I killed Diana, I'd have had to do it right before leaving, and Alice would have walked in basically right after. That's possible — but it's also possible someone else slipped into Medbay between me leaving and Alice arriving. Medbay connects to Cafeteria, Electrical, Upper Engine, and Storage — lots of access.

I know I look bad here. The opportunity argument is real. But I didn't kill Diana. If you vote me and I'm wrong, you'll know next round when someone dies again. I'd ask you to consider Eve and Charlie's routes more carefully too — Storage connects to Medbay.

I'm not going to beg. Vote how you see it.
